analyst_view.overall: Promoted Paderborn have drawn 0-0 in their last two league games and have won both home games this season. Adi Hütter calls them 'extremely unpleasant' at home, with a high press and a 5-3-2, and says Frankfurt must bring intensity and win lots of duels in a match he calls 'richtungsweisend' (one that sets the direction). Mario Götze is out with an ear infection and captain Robin Koch (knee knock) is in a race to be fit. Hütter has not said whether Ebnoutalib and Burkardt will start together.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. Paderborn come in on two goalless draws and Hütter expects a grind, with high pressing and lots of duels. Frankfurt are also without Götze as a creator, so we expect a tight game.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners. Paderborn's 5-3-2 relies on wing-backs for width, which the model already reflects, and nothing in the team news moves it.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.4 cards, which looks low for a game like this. Paderborn press high and Hütter says Frankfurt must win the battle of duels, which tends to bring fouls and bookings. Bastian Dankert referees.

shots.text: The numbers say 30 shots. Paderborn's recent games have been low-event (two 0-0 draws), and Frankfurt are without Götze, so a stop-start, physical game should produce fewer shots than the model expects.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. Two goalless draws in a row for Paderborn and Götze's absence for Frankfurt point to slightly fewer clear efforts.
